### What’s new

- Added Fedora support and an RPM package for x86_64 systems.
- Added an option to use the native Steam launcher instead of an installed wrapper.
- Improved package installation and removal guidance on Linux.

### Installation

- **Windows:** run `FST-Setup.exe`.
- **Fedora:** run `sudo dnf install ./fast-steam-tools-0.1.6-1.x86_64.rpm`.
- **Arch Linux:** run `sudo pacman -U ./fast-steam-tools-bin-0.1.6-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`.
- **Linux archive:** extract `fst-0.1.6-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, then run `bash install.sh` from the `fst-linux-x64` directory.

On Linux, native Steam, SLSsteam, lumalinux with `tools/steamidra_lite.py`, and Python 3 are required. See the [Linux installation guide](https://github.com/superhe11/FST/blob/v0.1.6/packaging/linux/README-LINUX.md) for details.

This is a prerelease. File checksums are available in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
